fields.value: Matlab implementation of 3GPP channel models based on TR38.901 and TR36.777 specifications

dsDescriptionValue.value: This package of codes collected all 3GPP path loss models, including LoS and NLoS loss, LoS probability. The codes are based on 3GPP document: TR38.901, TR36.777 and cover both terrestrial and aerial users. Five scenarios are included in the package, namely Rural Macrocell (RMa), Urban Macrocell (UMa), Urban Microcell (UMi), Indoor Hotspot (InH) and Indoor Factory (InF). We strongly recommend to cite the following papers when using our package: [1] W. Wang, J. Talvitie, E. J. Adamova, T. Fath, L. Korenciak, M. Valkama and E. S. Lohan. Empowering Heterogeneous Communication Data Links in General Aviation through mmWave Signals. IEEE Wireless Communications 26.6 (2019), 164–171. DOI: 10.1109/MWC.0001.1800593. [2] W. Wang, S. L. Capitaneanu, D. Marinca and E. S. Lohan. Comparative Analysis of Channel Models for Industrial IoT Wireless Communication. IEEE Access 7 (2019), 91627–91640. DOI: 10.1109/ACCESS.2019.2927217.
